name: Festering Blast

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Creatures in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line make Constitution saves against 4d10 Necrotic and Poisoned. Affected creatures take 2d10 Poison at turn start and repeat the save at turn end to end the spell on themselves. Success avoids the spell. Only the initial damage gains 1d10 per slot above 4.
